Blinky 1.5.9

  • Opening Blinky shows its main window. Finder, Spotlight, Launchpad, and the Dock open the window titled Blinky on the Appearance pane, and a launch at login stays in the menu bar unless Show main window when opened at login is on under Settings → General → Startup and windows. Docs/architecture.md #70
  • The Dock icon can stay on. Always show Dock icon, in that same section, keeps Blinky in the Dock and in ⌘-Tab, and Show Dock icon while a window is open still covers the main window, a recap, and the service chooser while that switch is off. #70
  • A login launch waits to ask. The service chooser and the first-run questions stay back until Blinky is opened by hand, and General explains it when the menu bar icon had to be turned back on. #70

Release notes on GitHub
